overview.summary: ub-agents develops itself with its own loop: every change reaches main as one reviewed, squash-merged PR. A maintainer labels an issue; agents prepare, build, review and merge it, and a maintainer steps in where an agent stops or a change touches a guarded path.
points: **Preparation.** The issue-preparer states the behavior and the smallest set of acceptance criteria.
**Implementation.** The implementer builds one PR, a reviewer on another model checks the exact head, and the integrator runs the final checks and merges.
**At any point** an agent that meets unclear intent, work too big for one PR or a decision only a maintainer can make stops with `needs-human`.

phases.name: Issue phase
phases.summary: The issue-preparer turns a new issue into criteria an implementer can build against, or asks a maintainer.

gates.name: Launcher
gates.rule: The trigger label is on the item, from a maintainer when approvals are on, and nothing holds it: no stop label, no open blocker, retries left.

gates.name: Preparation
gates.rule: The behavior and the smallest set of acceptance criteria are stated; an unexplained scope change or a PR-only prerequisite goes to `needs-human`.

gates.name: A maintainer answers
gates.rule: A maintainer answers on the issue, removes `needs-human` and re-adds `needs-preparation`.

notes: `queue.milestones: order` Priority always wins; at equal priority, issues from earlier milestones, in alphabetical order of their titles, go first. [Queue: Milestones](https://agents.uberblick.ai/docs/configuration/queue.html#milestones)

phases.name: Implementation and PR phase
phases.summary: One pull request passes from the implementer to the reviewer and the integrator, and back through needs-changes until it merges.

gates.name: Launcher
gates.rule: The trigger label is on the item, from a maintainer when approvals are on, and nothing holds it: no stop label, no open blocker, retries left.

gates.name: Handoff
gates.rule: Every check passes, the head merges cleanly and the PR is ready; otherwise it stays a draft and the run reports blocked.

gates.name: Review
gates.rule: Another model approves the exact head against the acceptance criteria; otherwise `changes-requested` sends it back to `needs-changes`.

gates.name: Merge
gates.rule: A green Test run and every owed review cover the exact head and the policy lets agents merge; guarded paths go to a maintainer.

gates.name: A maintainer merges
gates.rule: A maintainer answers or merges, removes `needs-human` and re-adds the trigger of the role that acts next.

notes: The implementer has no needs-human outcome: it stops by reporting blocked, which leaves an Action needed comment until a maintainer runs ub-agents retry.

roles.does: Rewrites the issue as final behavior and observable acceptance criteria; links prerequisites as blockers.
Builds or revises one draft PR, runs every check, marks it ready.
Reviews the exact head commit against the issue's criteria, on another CLI and model.
Merges the base in if behind, reruns the final checks, squash-merges or hands to a maintainer.
